DD/MM/YY
Sharon Wilkins,
"Prestige Home Care "
393 Victoria Road
Newtown
Dear Ms Wilkins,
Re: Aisha Amari, 75 years old
I am writing to refer Mrs Aisha Amari into your care who presented to our clinic today because of chronic ankle pain. Although she can walk independently, she requires some personal assistance in her home.
In terms of her medical history, Aisha has been suffering from hypertension for three years and type 2 diabetes for 18 months for which she is on a range of medications, as monitored by her son, and a particular diet. While her hearing and speech are good, she does have blurry vision as a result of retinal damage.
It is important to know that Aisha does not speak any English; she speaks Arabic. She also has some memory loss. Her son, Ahmed, is her interpreter and main carer. She carries a mobile phone on her at all times to communicate with Ahmed. Ahmed also reminds her of her medication.
Aisha requires your help with dressing, domestic chores and showering two days per week, four hours per day. Also, as there are no assistive devices in Aisha’s house, would you kindly arrange their installation?
Please do not hesitate to contact me for any assistance you require regarding this patient.
Yours sincerely,
Nurse
193 words
